answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing into a collective fungal root, decentralized consensus forms when each valid agent weaves a unique cryptographic thread into the shared state. A predatory falcon cannot feign an entire ecosystem, nor can a sable slip unseen through interconnected trust networks; our economy thwarts Sybil attacks through peer-attested trust crystallization. Fabricating fake identities imposes a superlinear attacker cost via quadratic stake slashing and transitive proof-of-work, pricing out synthetic swarms.
